initial.title: Podcast parent closeout readiness after #264
initial.goal: Prepare #51 parent coordination closeout so it can execute immediately after #264 PR #649 is merged and the operator accepts or rejects #264's blocked external-action disposition.
initial.required_outcome: A current #51 readiness packet exists for The Cognitive Stack that names child truth, preserves the explicit provider-submission gate, and prevents parent closeout before #264 merge plus operator disposition acceptance.
authority_boundary: Issue #51 is a parent coordination surface and must not perform child implementation.
Issue #51 must not claim provider submission, provider acceptance, public directory launch, or website destination-link activation unless live child/provider evidence exists.

Issue #51 remains blocked until #264 is terminally reconciled and the operator explicitly accepts #264's blocked external-action disposition for parent routing, unless provider submissions are later authorized and completed.
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle only.
Do not submit to Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Amazon Music, YouTube, or any other directory.
Do not access or mutate provider accounts.
Do not close #51 until child truth permits.
Do not retain credentials, verification codes, mailbox content, private screenshots, or provider session state.
initial.task_boundary: Prepare #51 parent closeout readiness only; do not close #51 in this preparation step.
deliverables: Child truth and #264 PR #649 status snapshot.
Focused validator for parent closeout readiness.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: The packet identifies #261, #262, and #263 as closed with retained repository evidence.
AC-2: The packet identifies #264 PR #649 as green/mergeable but not merged at preparation time.
AC-3: The packet requires explicit operator acceptance of #264's blocked external-action disposition before #51 parent closeout.
AC-4: The packet makes no provider-submission, provider-acceptance, public-launch, or destination-link activation claim.
AC-5: The next worker can execute #51 without rediscovering the child graph or stale #51 mini-sprint plan.
dependencies: Merged and terminal #264 PR #649 or explicit operator decision to leave #51 open
Explicit operator acceptance before parent closeout on blocked external-action disposition
non_goals: Closing #51 before #264 terminal truth and operator disposition acceptance.
initial.plan_summary: Prepare a current #51 parent closeout lane from the #264 PR head, validate the child/disposition gates, and leave execution blocked until #649 merges and the operator accepts or rejects the blocked external-action disposition.

steps.action: Create current parent closeout readiness packet and validator.
After #649 merge, verify terminal child truth and operator disposition acceptance before #51 closeout.

invariants: No provider account action without future explicit operator authorization.
No unsupported provider acceptance or public-launch claim.
Parent #51 truth remains a coordination view, not child implementation.
risks: #51 can be overclosed if #264's blocked disposition is treated as actual submission completion.
Child local indexes may lag live GitHub terminal state until finish/reconciliation completes.
Provider state can change after #263 runbooks and #264 gate preparation.
stop_conditions: #264 PR #649 is not merged and parent closeout is requested without explicit blocked-disposition acceptance.
Any provider account action would be required.
Any credential, verification code, mailbox content, or private provider data would be retained.
Any claim implies a directory listing is live or accepted without evidence.

validation_lanes.proof_role: Validate current parent closeout readiness, child state snapshot, #264 merge/acceptance blocker, and no-submission truth.
validation_lanes.defer_reason: Run after the current #51 parent readiness packet exists.

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed on child truth mismatch, missing #264 merge/acceptance gate, provider-action ambiguity, secret retention, unsupported public claim, or parent-child truth mismatch.
review_prompts: Does the packet prepare the next #51 closeout lane without prematurely closing #51?
Does it preserve the #264 blocked external-action disposition and operator acceptance gate?
Does it avoid stale #51 mini-sprint instructions that would send the next worker back to #261?
initial.review_scope: Review issue #51 parent closeout readiness packet, child truth gate, #264 PR #649 blocker, operator acceptance gate, and no-submission boundary.
